noteHint: A line for the invoice or for your own record
timeHint: Type 1.5 or 1:30 for hours, or 45m for minutes
timeInvalid: That is not a time. Try 1.5, 1:30 or 45m.

keywords.myWeek: timesheet hours log time timer week expenses
keywords.unbilled: work not yet invoiced wip invoice billing ageing
keywords.rates: hourly rate card prices cost titles

myWeek.title: My week
myWeek.hint: Log your hours, send the week for approval and record expenses.
myWeek.missing: Days with less time logged than usual:

timer.title: Timer
timer.hint: Start the timer when you begin; stop it when you finish and the time is saved for you.
timer.discardAsk: Throw this timer away without saving any time?
timer.longTitle: This timer has run for a very long time
timer.longHint: It shows {{time}}. Did you forget to stop it? Type the time you really worked.

week.submitAsk: You are sending {{total}} of time and {{expenses}} expenses. You will not be able to change them unless you take the week back or it is sent back to you.
week.recalledOk: Week taken back. You can change it again.
week.sentBack: Your manager sent this week back.
week.fixAndSend: Fix it and send it again.
week.waiting: This week is waiting for someone else to approve it. You cannot change it now.
week.pendingInbox: This week is waiting in the approvals inbox. You cannot change it now.
week.approvedNote: This week is approved and locked.

grid.empty: No time yet this week. Add a row, start the timer or log time.
grid.emptyLocked: No time was logged this week.
grid.rowExists: That row is already in the grid
grid.hint: Type hours like 1.5 or 1:30 and press Enter. Days that have not happened yet cannot be filled.
grid.belowOthers: That day already has {{time}} from the timer or quick log. Change those entries below instead.

entries.title: Logged one by one
entries.hint: Time from the timer and from quick logging, with notes.
entries.none: Nothing here. Time you log with the timer or the Log time button shows up here.
entries.noneProject: No time logged on this project yet
entries.noneProjectHint: Try a wider date range, or ask the team to log their hours.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.hint: Things bought for a client's project that you can charge on.
expenses.receiptNeeded: A receipt is needed before you can send the week in. Take a photo or choose a file.
expenses.receiptOptional: Add a photo of the receipt now, or later by editing the expense.
expenses.receiptRequiredAbove: A receipt is needed for amounts of {{amount}} and over.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.hint: Check your team's weeks and approve them, or send them back with a reason.
approvals.noneWaitingHint: When someone sends their week it will appear here.
approvals.approveAsk: Approve this week? The time becomes ready to invoice.
approvals.sendBackHint: The person will see this and can fix and send again.
approvals.reopenHint: Only possible while nothing from this week has been invoiced.
approvals.ownWeek: This is your own week. Someone else must approve it.
approvals.inInbox: This week is waiting in the approvals inbox. Decide it there.
approvals.notSubmittedHint: Weeks that have ended where the person has time but has not sent it.
approvals.noInvoices: No invoices are waiting for a partner

overview.title: Team time
overview.hint: How much each person worked and how much of it can be billed.
overview.badRange: The end date must be after the start date
overview.emptyHint: Pick another period, or ask the team to log their time.

projects.title: Projects
projects.hint: The work you do for clients, with budgets and how each is billed.
projects.emptyHint: Add a project for a client so your team can log time against it.
projects.codeHint: A short code such as WEB-01. It cannot be changed later.
projects.name: Project name

modeHint.time_and_materials: Time is billed at the hourly rate.
modeHint.fixed_fee: One price, billed in stages as you finish them.
modeHint.retainer: The client pays ahead for hours, or a fee each month.
modeHint.capped_fee: Time is billed at the rates, but never more than the cap.

projects.branchHint: Leave on all branches unless one branch owns this project.
projects.fixedFeeHint: The total the client pays for the whole project.
projects.budgetHoursHint: Total hours planned, for example 40:00. Leave empty for none.
projects.budgetAmountHint: Most you plan to bill. Leave empty for none.
projects.serviceItemHint: The service this project is invoiced under.
projects.feeCapHint: The most this project can be billed in time. Work above it is recorded but written off automatically.
projects.templateHint: Sets the kind of fee, hours, repeating work, checklist and milestones for you.

summary.waitingApprovalHint: Time logged but not approved, so not ready to invoice
summary.over: This project has gone over its budget.
summary.near: This project is close to its budget.
summary.capUsed: Value of the work against the cap
summary.overCap: {{amount}} of work is above the cap and cannot be billed.
summary.capHint: Hours keep being recorded; when an invoice is made, the part above the cap is written off with the reason "fee cap".

milestones.hint: For fixed-price projects: split the price into stages. A stage is invoiced once you mark it ready.
milestones.name: Stage
milestones.emptyHint: Add the stages of this project and what each is worth.
milestones.differs: The stages add up to {{total}} but the fixed price is {{fee}}.

retainer.emptyHint: Set one up to track prepaid hours or a monthly fee.
retainer.kindHoursHint: The client buys hours ahead. Approved time uses them up.
retainer.kindFeeHint: The client pays the same fee each month, whatever the hours.
retainer.expiresHint: Unused hours are lost after this date. Leave empty for never.
retainer.alertHint: Percent used at which to warn
retainer.openingHint: Hours the client has already paid for outside this system, for example 10:00.
retainer.nearlyUsed: {{percent}}% of the prepaid hours are used. Time to bill a top-up.
retainer.usedUp: The prepaid hours are used up ({{percent}}%).
retainer.topupHint: This starts an invoice review for the new hours. The hours are added once the invoice is issued.
retainer.feeHint: This starts an invoice review for one month of the fee ({{fee}}).
retainer.noHistory: Nothing has happened on this retainer yet
retainer.autoDraftHint: A draft invoice review appears on that day. Nothing is sent until you issue it.

clients.title: Clients
clients.hint: The clients you bill for time, what is waiting to be invoiced and how they pay.
clients.emptyHint: Add a project for a customer and they will appear here.
clients.termsHint: How many days after the invoice the client should pay. Leave empty to use the business default.
clients.groupingHint: How this client's time is grouped on the invoice.
clients.notesHint: Anything the person who invoices should know, such as a purchase order number.
clients.markupHint: Used for this client's expenses when none is typed. Leave empty to use the business's.

unbilled.title: Unbilled work
unbilled.hint: Work that is approved but not yet invoiced, and how old it is.
unbilled.emptyHint: Approved time and expenses will appear here.
unbilled.unpriced: {{time}} of time has no hourly rate, so it is worth nothing yet. Add a rate on the Rate cards page.

reviews.title: Invoice reviews
reviews.emptyHint: Start one from the work above.

review.title: Invoice review: {{client}}
review.draftNote: Nothing is invoiced yet. Check the lines, change what you need, then issue the invoice.
review.problems: Fix these before you can issue the invoice:
review.noLines: This review has no lines left. Add one, or discard the review.
review.descriptionHint: What the client will read on the invoice
review.timeLineHint: Hours can go down to write time off (give a reason) but not above {{max}}, what was worked. Type 36:00 or 36 for a long line.
review.serviceItemHint: The service this line is invoiced under. Leave empty to use the default.
review.removeAsk: Take this line off the invoice? Its time or expenses go back to unbilled work.
review.lineRemoved: Line taken off. The work is back in unbilled work.
review.taxNote: The exact tax is worked out when the invoice is issued.
review.groupHint: Changing this rebuilds the time lines.
review.roundingHint: Changing this rebuilds the time lines.
review.payDaysHint: Payment is due this many days after the invoice.
review.rebuildAsk: The time lines will be made again. Wording or hours you changed on them will be replaced.
review.issueAsk: Issue an invoice to {{client}} for {{amount}} before tax? You cannot change it afterwards.
review.issuedBody: This review can no longer be changed.
review.discardAsk: Throw this review away? All its work goes back to unbilled work.
review.branchHint: The invoice is issued by this branch.
review.reasonHint: For example: goodwill, our error, over the estimate
review.writeDownHint: This bills {{amount}} less than the work is worth. The time itself is not changed.
review.writeOffHint: Nothing will be billed for this line. The time stays on record as written off.
review.partnerOnly: Only a partner can write a line off completely.
review.cannotExceed: This line can be billed at most {{amount}}. To charge more, add a line of your own.

problem.no_service: Line {{line}} has no service item to invoice under
problem.partner_review: A partner has to review this invoice before it goes out
problem.over_cap: This would bill more than the project's fee cap

review.creditHelp: The client has no credit limit that covers this invoice. Invoices to clients are on account: give the client a credit limit and payment days in Customers, then issue again.

rates.title: Rate cards
rates.hint: What an hour of work is billed at, and what it costs you.
rates.how: When more than one rate fits a piece of work, the most specific wins, in this order:

order.client: then a rate for the client
order.person: then a rate for the person
order.service: then a rate for the service
order.role: then a rate for the job title

rates.howTie: If two are equally specific, the one that starts later wins. If nothing fits, the time has no rate and is not worth anything until you add one.
rates.billEmptyHint: Add a rate so time can be priced.
rates.costHint: What an hour costs you. Only people allowed to see costs can see this.
rates.kindBillHint: What the client pays for an hour.
rates.kindCostHint: What an hour of this work costs you.
rates.coversHint: Fill in only what this rate is for. Leave everything empty for a rate that applies to all work.
rates.fixedCover: What a rate applies to cannot be changed. To change it, end this rate and add a new one.
rates.roleHint: For example Senior consultant. Matches people whose title is set under Staff titles.
rates.toHint: Leave empty if it has no end date.
rates.deleteAsk: Delete this rate? Work already priced keeps its price.
rates.checkHint: Pick some work and see which rate would price it.
rates.resultFrom: This comes from a rate set for: {{covers}}.
rates.noResult: No rate fits. Time like this has no price yet.
rates.exampleNote: The rates marked Example came with your industry pack. They price nothing until you press "Use this rate" on each one (change the number first if it is not yours).

staff.hint: A person's title lets you set rates by job title. Weekly hours are what they are expected to work.
staff.name: Person
staff.capacityHint: For example 40:00. Leave empty to use the business default.
staff.countsInReports: Include this person in team reports
staff.approverHint: Asked first. Anyone else with the approve permission can still do it.
staff.awayHint: No time reminders meanwhile, and as an approver they are skipped.
staff.reminders: Send this person reminders to log time

settings.title: Time settings
settings.hint: How time is entered, approved and invoiced.
settings.minuteStepHint: Time is entered in multiples of this, for example 15 minutes.
settings.weekStartHint: The first day of a timesheet week.
settings.timerRoundHint: When you stop the timer, its time is rounded to this.
settings.timerModeHint: Up always goes higher, nearest picks the closest, down always goes lower.
settings.capacityHint: Used to show how busy people are, for example 40:00.
settings.approvalRequiredHint: If off, a week is approved as soon as it is sent.
settings.ratesIncludeTaxHint: Turn on if the hourly rates you set already contain tax.
settings.serviceItemHint: Time is invoiced under this service when a project has none.
settings.expenseItemHint: Expenses are invoiced under this item.
settings.invoiceRoundHint: The starting choice for each invoice review.
settings.groupHint: The starting choice for each invoice review.
settings.budgetAlertHint: Percent of a project's budget at which to warn.
settings.unsubmittedHint: Days after a week ends before an unsent timesheet is flagged.
settings.unbilledHint: Days after approval before waiting work is flagged.
settings.retentionHint: Notes on time entries are cleared after this many days. Leave empty to keep them.
settings.partnerReview: Partner review before invoices go out
settings.partnerReviewHint: An invoice review must be approved by someone with the partner permission (or issued by one).
settings.remindHint: A week or invoice nobody has looked at. 0 turns reminders off.
settings.escalate: Remind everyone who can approve after (days)
settings.escalateHint: Then again every week while it waits.
settings.markupHint: Added to expenses unless the client or the expense says otherwise. 0 bills at cost.
settings.receiptHint: A week cannot be sent in while an expense this size or more has no receipt. Empty: never required.
settings.nudgesHint: People who log time get a message the next morning when a working day has too little. Messages follow each person's own settings and quiet hours.
settings.nudgeMinutes: Least time on a working day
settings.nudgeMinutesHint: Such as 6:00. Empty turns the reminders off.
settings.nudgeHourHint: The hour of the day in the business's time zone.

narrative.title: Account of the work
narrative.hint: Written from the notes people made on their time. Send it with the invoice if the client asks what the hours were for.
narrative.textHint: You can change it. It is saved when you leave the box. It is not printed on the invoice itself.
narrative.intoLines: Also put a short version in the invoice lines

owner.ageing: How long the unbilled work has waited
owner.realisationNote: Realisation is the share of the work's worth that was billed on invoices in this period.
owner.utilisationHint: Billable hours over what the team could work
owner.atRiskNone: No project is near its budget.

partner.title: Partner review
partner.hintRequired: A partner has to look at this invoice before it goes out. Any change you make afterwards asks for approval again.
partner.hintOptional: You can ask a partner to look at this invoice before it goes out.
partner.noteHint: The person who built the invoice will see this.
partner.waiting: Waiting for a partner to look at it.

practice.templatesHint: A starting point for a new project: kind of fee, hours, repeating work, checklist and milestones.
practice.deleteAsk: Delete this? Projects already made from it are not changed.
practice.name: Name
practice.milestonesHint: One per line: name | share of the fee in %. They should add up to 100.
practice.activitiesHint: The names people pick for what they did, offered as suggestions on every time box.
practice.wordingHint: Short notes you can add to an invoice with one click, in English or Swahili.
practice.textHint: Up to 500 characters (the invoice note limit).

step.service_item: Choose what invoices are made under
step.team: Give your team their job titles

hint.service_item: Settings > billing: one service item for time and one for expenses.
hint.rates: Without a rate, time is logged but cannot be invoiced.
hint.team: Rates can follow the title (Partner, Associate).
hint.client_project: Start from a template to get the fee type and checklist.
hint.time: Use the timer or the week grid.
hint.invoice: Approve a week, then start an invoice review from Unbilled work.

start.exampleRates: {{count}} example rates still wait to be confirmed on the Rates page.
start.sampleHint: Fill the business with a sample practice to try things out.
start.sampleLoaded: The sample practice is loaded. Time you have sent in or invoiced stays when you remove it.
start.removeAsk: Remove the sample projects, time and deadlines? The sample clients stay in Customers (archive them there).

work.title: Deadlines
work.hint: Dated client work with its checklist: monthly closes, returns, filings.
work.noneHint: Repeating work and deadlines you add to a project appear here.
work.emptyHint: Add repeating work (a monthly close) or a single deadline.
work.name: What is it
work.nameHint: For example: Monthly close, Annual return
work.dueDayHint: Day of the month. Day 31 means the last day of shorter months.
work.dueMonthQuarterly: The first of the three-monthly dates
work.lead: Prepare it this many days ahead
work.leadHint: The task appears, and reminds whoever does it, this long before it is due.
